text: 前天晚上上床睡觉，侧身躺下，胯骨略疼。
en: The night before last, when I went to bed and lay down on my side, my hip bone ached slightly.

text: 用手轻轻按压胯骨还是疼。
en: Pressing the hip bone gently with my hand still hurt.

text: 第二天告诉媳妇，媳妇惊讶说不会是股骨头吧。
en: The next day I told my wife, and she said in surprise, 'Surely it can't be the femoral head?'

text: 我开始查股骨头，经查，几乎又是不治之症。
en: I started looking up the femoral head, and upon checking, it turned out to be yet another incurable disease.

text: 我84年，今年虚岁41。
en: I was born in '84, and this year I am 41 by nominal age.

text: 前段时间咽口水感觉咽喉有异物，怀疑咽喉有问题，但又不想去医院，于是就戒了抽了20年的烟。
en: A while ago, when I swallowed, my throat felt as though there were a foreign object; I suspected something was wrong with my throat, but did not want to go to hospital, so I gave up the cigarettes I had smoked for 20 years.

text: 去年下胃镜查的喷门炎和浅表性胃炎，近期感觉又有胃胀气，于是把酒也戒了。
en: Last year an endoscopy found cardia inflammation and superficial gastritis; recently I felt bloated again, so I gave up alcohol too.

text: 戒烟戒酒了，也不能总闲着吧，就想着多运动运动，每周去公园打打篮球。
en: Having given up smoking and drinking, I could not just stay idle, so I thought I would exercise more, playing basketball in the park each week.

text: 这打了还没3月，胯骨开始不舒服了。
en: I had not even been playing three months when my hip bone started to feel uncomfortable.

text: 这才刚到40岁，就开始这不舒服、那不舒服了，看来岁数大了，能静养就静养吧。
en: I had only just turned 40 and already things ached here and there; it seems age is catching up, so I might as well rest and recuperate when I can.

text: 曾经看到一段话，大概意思是你21岁大学毕业，25岁有一个孩子，30岁之前二胎，35岁赚到足够的钱，保持健康，这样一生才可以有足够的时间和精力来过最自我的人生。
en: I once read a passage, roughly meaning: you graduate from university at 21, have a child at 25, a second child before 30, earn enough money by 35, and stay healthy, and only then can you have enough time and energy in life to live the most self-true life.

text: 大约翻译过来，还是张爱玲的那句出名要趁早，什么都趁早。
en: Roughly translated, it is still that line of Ailing Zhang's: 'achieve fame early, do everything early.'

text: 但是我发现我过了四十岁后，很多东西都不在计划内。
en: But I found that after turning forty, many things fell outside the plan.

text: 尤其发现赚钱不容易。
en: Especially I found that earning money is not easy.

text: 但是最终我还是越来越宽容了。
en: But in the end I have become more and more tolerant.

text: 有的人结婚很早，有的人很晚，也有人不结婚。
en: Some marry very early, some very late, and some do not marry at all.

text: 有的人结婚很久后才有孩子，有的人早早开始生孩子，有的人不生孩子。
en: Some have children only long after marriage, some start having children early, and some have no children.

text: 那又怎样，每个人的人生，都是和自己的选择有关。
en: So what — everyone's life is bound up with their own choices.

text: 看起来有的人走在前面，有的人落后，但其实最终没有人落后，只是时机未到。
en: It may look as though some are ahead and some are behind, but in truth no one ends up behind; it is just that the moment has not yet arrived.

text: 无论什么状况，要学会的，一直是平静面对每个时间点里那个有时候觉得不堪有时候觉得特别好的自己。
en: Whatever the situation, what we must always learn is to calmly face, at every point in time, the self that sometimes feels unbearable and sometimes feels especially good.

text: 养大宝时，我有段时间天天盼望我的孩子可以早早长大，不需要我陪着去上课，不需要担心她一个人回家，不需要担心她吃什么。
en: When raising Dabao, there was a period when I wished every day that my child would grow up quickly, so I would not need to accompany her to class, worry about her walking home alone, or worry about what she ate.

text: 还希望她能主动学会做家务，学习有好习惯，努力学习之余能把房间保持的特别整齐干净。
en: I also hoped she would take the initiative to learn housework, develop good study habits, and keep her room especially tidy and clean alongside her hard studying.

text: 听起来简单但是其实实现了这些，我已经觉得自己都拥有一个完美的小孩了。
en: It sounds simple, but in truth, once those were achieved, I would already have felt I had a perfect child.

text: 但是她一年比一年独立，我却又一年比一年对她有更高的期望。
en: But she grows more independent year by year, and yet my expectations of her grow higher year by year.

text: 我看到她有自己的圈子，和我出门时候，虽然习惯性把手放到我口袋，我们聊天时候却大多是她讲我听。
en: I see she has her own circle of friends; when we go out together, although she habitually slips her hand into my pocket, when we chat it is mostly her talking and me listening.

text: 我总是觉得她讲得这些琐碎的烦恼和同学间的矛盾争吵，以及她觉得特别好笑的事，都是幼稚的小事情。
en: I always felt the trifling worries she spoke of, the conflicts and quarrels with classmates, and the things she found especially funny, were all childish little matters.

text: 想来，当时她也是不能理解，大人为什么烦恼的东西都以为那么大。
en: Thinking back, she too could not understand then why the things adults worried about seemed so very large.

text: 但是，等过到今天，年纪到了四十多，我想我原来一直很羡慕更年轻的那个自己。
en: But, having reached today, in my forties, I think I have always envied the younger version of myself.

text: 但也珍惜今天最年轻的自己。
en: But I also cherish the youngest version of myself today.

text: 早上大宝起来去图书馆写作业，二宝和老公去西湖边喂鸽子。
en: In the morning Dabao got up and went to the library to do homework, while Erbao and my husband went to the Xi Hu shore to feed the pigeons.

text: 我听了网络课，刚好一小时，洗衣机洗好的衣服，在暖暖的阳光里晒衣服时，内心全是幸福。
en: I listened to an online class, exactly an hour; as I hung out the clothes the washing machine had washed in the warm sunshine, my heart was full of happiness.

text: 想起昨晚和老公聊天时候，我说，我觉得我们的日子很幸福，这种幸福无法表达。
en: I recalled last night when chatting with my husband, I said, 'I feel our life is very happy, a happiness that cannot be expressed.'

text: 我没有和公婆父母住，他们身体都还健康。
en: I do not live with my parents-in-law or my own parents, and they are all still in good health.

text: 逢年过节回去我是他们最欢迎的客人。
en: When I go back for festivals and holidays, I am their most welcome guest.

text: 我不工作快三年，大多时间宅家里，爱怎么过怎么过。
en: I have not worked for nearly three years, mostly staying at home, living exactly as I please.

text: 结婚近20年的老公和我越来越少吵架，即使我是全职妈妈，他也依然保持每天给我们做早餐的习惯。
en: My husband, married nearly 20 years, and I quarrel less and less; even though I am a full-time mother, he still keeps up the habit of making breakfast for us every day.

text: 他所有的坏习惯都没改，但是我慢慢接受，解决不了的就算了吧。
en: None of his bad habits have changed, but I have slowly accepted it; what cannot be fixed, let it be.

text: 比起外貌和智商，我知道平和，耐心，勤劳，对生活充满激情的人就是特别好的伴侣。
en: Compared with looks and IQ, I know that a person who is peaceful, patient, hardworking, and full of passion for life is a truly good companion.

text: 也希望我的孩子可以有这样的品质。
en: I also hope my children can have such qualities.

text: 现在我们没有很多钱，但是感觉也算衣食无忧。
en: Now we do not have much money, but we feel we are free from worry about food and clothing.

text: 内心踏实安稳。
en: My heart is steady and at peace.

text: 四十岁，我觉得我真的接受了很多东西，也知道很多东西是不得不接受，不和自己过不去，也不太在意别人的评价，让自己过得幸福是最重要的。
en: At forty, I feel I have truly accepted many things, and I know many things simply must be accepted; not to be hard on myself, not to care too much about others' judgements — making myself happy is what matters most.

text: 中年人的慢生活：最滋养自己的活法，不是躺平、睡觉、刷手机，是这3种方式
en: The slow life of middle-aged people: the way of living that nourishes oneself most is not lying flat, sleeping, or scrolling on the phone, but these three ways

text: 在快节奏的钢铁森林里，小孩有趣，老人有闲，中年人好像只有解决不完的糟心事。
en: In the fast-paced steel forest, children are fun, the elderly have leisure, but middle-aged people seem to have only endless bothers.

text: 当父母向你索取关注，小孩找你要奶喝，你也想拥有那么一刻，只属于你自己的慢生活吧。
en: When parents demand your attention and children come asking for milk, you too want to have that one moment of slow life that belongs only to yourself.

text: 中年人的慢生活：最滋养自己的活法，不是躺平、睡觉、耍手机，是这3种方式——独处、疗愈身心、做喜欢的事情。
en: The slow life of middle-aged people: the way of living that nourishes oneself most is not lying flat, sleeping, or playing on the phone, but these three ways — solitude, healing body and mind, and doing what you love.

text: 图/阿经
en: Image/A Jing

text: 独处：中年人更需要和自己待一会儿。
en: Solitude: middle-aged people need even more to spend a while with themselves.

text: 人到中年，8小时卖给了老板，8小时被鸡毛蒜皮切碎，8小时睡觉、吃饭、上厕所。
en: When you reach middle age, eight hours are sold to the boss, eight hours are chopped up by trivialities, and eight hours for sleeping, eating, and using the toilet.

text: 中年人最缺的是独处。
en: What middle-aged people lack most is solitude.

text: 人只有在独处的时候，才能真正地摒除喧嚣，获得内心的宁静。
en: Only in solitude can one truly shut out the noise and gain inner peace.

text: 寻一处安静少人的公园，一座书香四溢的图书馆，清晨无人的运动场。
en: Seek out a quiet, uncrowded park, a library overflowing with the scent of books, a sports ground empty in the early morning.

text: 发呆、阅读、跑步，都是极佳的独处方式。
en: Daydreaming, reading, running — all are excellent ways to be alone.

text: 图/阿经
en: Image/A Jing

text: 在独处中，身处宁静的场域，不会有外力干扰你的思绪。
en: In solitude, in a peaceful setting, no external force will disturb your thoughts.

text: 你可以安心整理自己内心的秩序，扫除焦虑、恐惧、惆怅，让沉稳、有序、聚焦、平静住进来。
en: You can peacefully tidy the order within your heart, sweeping away anxiety, fear, and melancholy, and letting steadiness, order, focus, and calm move in.

text: 心随境转。
en: The heart shifts with its surroundings.

text: 在此刻，你可以让自己的呼吸慢下来，让决策慢下来，让目标慢下来。
en: In this moment, you can let your breathing slow down, let your decisions slow down, let your goals slow down.

text: 图/阿经
en: Image/A Jing

text: 身在当下，心在当下的人，才能真正地做自己，而不是活在别人对你的期待里。
en: Only those who are present in body and present in mind can truly be themselves, rather than living in others' expectations of you.

text: 图/阿经
en: Image/A Jing

text: 疗愈身心：向外输出经济、情绪、繁衍价值的同时，要及时滋养内心。
en: Healing body and mind: while outputting economic, emotional, and reproductive value outward, you must nourish your inner self in time.

text: 中年人的累，绝对不是一天垒起来的。
en: The exhaustion of middle-aged people is absolutely not built up in a single day.

text: 是无数个日日夜夜的睡眠被切碎，是无数次的钱包被切碎，是无数个鸡零狗碎累积而成的。
en: It is built from countless days and nights of sleep being chopped up, countless times of wallets being drained, countless trivialities piling up.

text: 向外输出自己的经济、情绪、繁衍价值的同时，要及时补充自己的能量缺口。
en: While outputting your own economic, emotional, and reproductive value outward, you must timely replenish your energy deficit.

text: 如何避免自己走到被一根稻草压垮的境地？
en: How to avoid reaching the point where a single straw crushes you?

text: 就是要及时疗愈自己。
en: It is to heal yourself in time.

text: 疗愈自己不是一蹴而就的，要融入你的日常。
en: Healing yourself is not achieved overnight; it must be woven into your daily life.

text: 在自己的内心修建一座桃花源，随时可以给自己提供能量。
en: Build a Peach Blossom Spring within your own heart, ready to provide you with energy at any time.

text: 图/阿经
en: Image/A Jing

text: 爬一座高山，开辟自己的小菜园，融入一个高能量的社交圈，都是不错的疗愈自己身心的具体方式。
en: Climbing a high mountain, starting your own small vegetable garden, joining a high-energy social circle — all are good concrete ways to heal your body and mind.

text: 图/阿经
en: Image/A Jing

text: 做喜欢的事情：那么多被逼无奈的时刻，要留一刻做自己喜欢的事情。
en: Doing what you love: amid so many moments of forced helplessness, keep a moment for doing what you love.

text: 中年牛马，那么多没得选的时刻，一定要强行留出一刻，不躺平、不睡觉、不耍手机，做自己喜欢的事情。
en: Middle-aged workhorses, in so many moments where there is no choice, you must forcibly carve out a moment — not lying flat, not sleeping, not playing on the phone — to do what you love.

text: 如果你喜欢书法，你就去买纸笔；
en: If you like calligraphy, go and buy paper and brushes;

text: 如果你喜欢插花，就去买花材、花瓶；
en: If you like flower arranging, go and buy flowers and a vase;

text: 如果你喜欢大自然，就奔向森林田野；
en: If you like nature, head for the forests and fields;

text: 喜欢摄影就不停拍下自己所遇见的每一刻美好。
en: If you love photography, keep photographing every beautiful moment you encounter.

text: 图/阿经
en: Image/A Jing

text: 小孩子有小孩子的玩具，大人自然也要擅长找自己的乐头。
en: Children have children's toys; adults naturally must also be good at finding their own fun.

text: 把时间花在自己喜欢的事情上，就不叫浪费时间。
en: Spending time on what you love is not called wasting time.

text: 某天看到一个博主，分享自己爱画画，于是把自己接触到的各种材质的废物：
en: One day I saw a blogger who shared that he loves painting, and so took all sorts of discarded objects of various materials he came across:

text: 一块布、一块木头、一个空白的杯子，都画上自己喜欢的小鸟、花草、人物。
en: a piece of cloth, a block of wood, a blank cup — and painted his favourite little birds, flowers, plants, and figures on them.

text: 渐渐地越画越多，越画越好，便有人慕名找他画。
en: Gradually he painted more and more, better and better, and people came to seek him out by reputation to paint.

text: 哪怕不被别人喜欢，自己乐在其中不也是美事一桩？
en: Even if others do not like it, is not finding joy in it oneself a beautiful thing?

text: 图/阿经
en: Image/A Jing

text: 中年人的慢生活：最滋养自己的活法，不是躺平、睡觉、刷手机，是以上3种方式。
en: The slow life of middle-aged people: the way of living that nourishes oneself most is not lying flat, sleeping, or scrolling on the phone, but the three ways above.

text: 世界越快，心越慢。
en: The faster the world, the slower the heart.

text: 希望你也能在自己繁忙的间隙，开辟出一方慢境，哪怕是中年人，也有自己的日常小美好。
en: I hope you too can, in the gaps of your busy life, carve out a slow realm; even as a middle-aged person, you have your own everyday little beauties.

text: 觉得我说得对？
en: Think I'm right?

text: 点个❤+关注，与你共勉。
en: Tap the ❤ + follow, and may we encourage each other.

en: Image/pexels
